description: This PHP source file defines the 'Subordinate' Data Transfer Object (DTO) class within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It facilitates normalizing subordinate employee data for reports, including fetching subordinate details and reporting methods.

classes.name: Subordinate
classes.description: A DTO class representing a subordinate employee for reporting purposes, providing normalization logic and subordinate-specific data retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Subordinate DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts subordinate data into an array format based on specified fields.

methods.name: callGetterOnItem
methods.description: Fetches specific subordinate-related information, such as reporting method, by invoking appropriate getters.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of fields to their corresponding getter methods for normalizing subordinate data.
